deploybot: :rotating_light: Deploy starting: tagged release `v1.9.8-hotfix.2` -> prod-eu1
- commit: a1b2c3d4
- change window: 2026-06-12 03:00-03:30 UTC
- rollout plan: canary 10% eu-west -> 50% eu-west -> promotion to prod-eu1 if green
- estimated duration: ~12m
- rollbacks: `/deploy rollback v1.9.8-hotfix.2 --env prod-eu1`

sarah.choi: Quick question: are we pinning the inference tokenizer to `v3.1-quant` for this hotfix? last time unpinned tokenizers caused small perf spikes.

mike.perez: Good call. If not pinned, abort threshold: latency p95 > 250ms for 3 consecutive mins.
Rollback steps I recommend:
```
# revert traffic
/deploy promote v1.9.8-hotfix.1 --env prod-eu1 --percent 100
# then run cleanup
/deploy cleanup v1.9.8-hotfix.2 --env prod-eu1
```
I'll be on standby.

julia.hernandez: Confirmed: tokenizer pinned in this tag to `v3.1-quant` and no DB migrations in this build. Safe to proceed from data side.

release-coordinator: Added release notes and short changelog: https://redwood.internal/releases/1.9.8-hotfix-2 :memo:  — includes fix for bad cache key handling and small perf regression.
Tagging @oncall and @infra for visibility.

ops-bot: Canary healthcheck: eu-west/10% => OK (error rate < 0.1%, cpu < 65%) :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Canary step 2: expanding to 50% eu-west now. Monitoring for 5m.

ops-bot: Canary healthcheck: eu-west/50% => OK (latency p95 180ms, error rate 0.05%) :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Promotion: cutting over to prod-eu1 now. Traffic shifting.

mike.perez: observing logs, no spike seen. thumbs

deploybot: Deploy complete — `v1.9.8-hotfix.2` promoted to prod-eu1. Duration: 9m. No rollbacks required. :tada:

release-coordinator: Great — I'll update the incident log and ship notes. Thanks everyone.
